title: WebCap Storyboard Scene Plan
description: Structured output contract for planning an ordered Story into independently generatable Scenes. WebCap assigns canonical Scene IDs after validation.

summary.description: Concrete visible/audible intent for this one generation unit. Detailed cinematography belongs to the prompt unless essential to Story intent.

entryState.description: What must already be true when this Scene begins.

exitState.description: What should be true when this Scene ends.

suggestedDurationSeconds.description: Suggested MiniMax H3 clip duration in seconds for the current Storyboard workflow.

continuesPreviousScene.description: True when this Scene directly inherits the previous Scene's exit state rather than acting as a continuity reset.

carryForward.description: Changed state established by this Scene that must remain true later until superseded.

prompt.description: Scene-specific MiniMax H3 base prompt content.

integrated_multimodal_description.description: Chronological audiovisual action/camera description for this Scene. Begin with [Shot 1]; later shots may use H3 cut timestamps.

overall_soundscape.description: Clip-wide ambience, Foley, impacts, and non-dialogue diegetic sound.

non_diegetic_music.description: Audience-only score, or N/A when no non-diegetic score is intended.
